name: TriangleCOPA
description: TriangleCOPA is a benchmark consisting of 100 textual questions paired with videos depicting movements of simple shapes, designed to evaluate vision-language models' capabilities in visual anthropomorphism and abstract interpretation.
reputation: A niche multimodal benchmark with limited adoption, mainly used in research on visual commonsense and anthropomorphic reasoning.
notes: Focuses on assessing vision-language models on abstract interpretation and visual anthropomorphism using video stimuli.
